searchText: <@!539495253418180618> look great. two notes. 1. in 4863, you write > If a block contains any transactions with WITHDRAWAL_TX_TYPE type, they MUST come after ALL other transactions in the block. but later on > By requiring all withdrawal transactions to be at the front of every block guessing you mean "at the back of every block"? 2. for 4865, a point of clarification. correct me if I'm wrong but I think that *all* balance changes in current Ethereum are the result of either a transaction or block reward. 4865 could mention that all software that tracks the history of an account (block explorers, chain analysis tools, wallets, etc) will have to add support for a third type of balance-changing event.
